praise: Copy is concrete and local — 17210 Bothell Way NE, hours, phone, 'diagnostics before dollars', 'approve before we wrench' — specific services with real pricing etiquette, zero lorem ipsum or 'welcome to our website'.
Palette is disciplined and clearly tuned to an auto-repair brand: deep navy + orange + gold, two warm accents used consistently; no generic gradient soup.
Hero hierarchy nails the one-visit test: name → clear offer ('honest repairs, clear pricing') → one primary phone CTA, with address and hours one line above it.
Motion (word-by-word h2 reveals, count-ups, magnetic CTAs, aurora) is fully gated behind prefers-reduced-motion and no-JS fallbacks, with sticky service-stack cards as a genuinely considered touch.

praise: Color discipline: a navy/orange/gold family that reads unmistakably automotive and local — no gradient soup, and the brand→brand2 gradient is reused consistently across buttons, scrollbar, and loader rather than invented per-section.

Copy is specific and confident: "Diagnostics before dollars", "100+ point check", full-synthetic oil, the street address in the topbar, and real attributed review quotes. No lorem, no 'welcome to our website'.

Typography pairing (Archivo Black display + Archivo body) is coherent, with sensible clamp scales and ~640px line lengths; the reveal/count-up/parallax motion is gated behind reduced-motion and no-JS so the decoration never owns the page.
One-visit test passes instantly: business name, trade, address, and a phone number appear in the topbar, sticky header, hero, and footer.
